## Measurable Track Record & Quantitative Impact
- **Global Workforce Management:** Directed People Operations and Talent Development for 500+ employees distributed across 26 countries.
- **Deterministic HR Automation:** Engineered automated pipelines connecting Google Workspace, webhooks, and custom HRIS, reducing redundant administrative work by 30% to 95%.
- **Performance Evaluation Speedup:** Slashed monthly staff evaluation compilation from 48 hours to 15-30 minutes semi-realtime via custom internal applications released to Google Play Store & Apple App Store. Awarded *Best HR of the Year 2023* (Mr. BOB Kampung Inggris).
- **Zero-Cost Internal LMS Architecture:** Built a complete in-house Learning Management System from scratch for TEI Recruitment using internal Google Workspace infrastructure, managing 100+ international trainees and 5-7 trainers without third-party vendor lock-in or recurring SaaS licensing fees. Lifted talent retention by +30%.
- **Aviation Career & English Mentorship:** Coached 150+ cabin crew and ground staff candidates at Aeronef Academy and Jogja Flight in personality development, mental job readiness, and professional Aviation English.
- **Total Mentorship Reach:** Mentored and coached over 1,150 individual professionals, university graduates, and corporate talents.
